# MAP.md — Project Navigation

## System Summary

OSDEP is the foundational OS abstraction layer for all EmbedThis modules. It is delivered as a single header (`osdep.h`) that uses preprocessor detection to provide cross-platform portability across embedded and desktop systems including Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, Windows, VxWorks, FreeRTOS/ESP32, QNX, Solaris, and more. The module has zero runtime dependencies — all abstraction is compile-time.

## Module Structure

```
osdep/
    osdep.h         # Primary header -- the entire module
    CLAUDE.md       # AI documentation
    Makefile        # Utility targets (doc, format, test, package, publish)
    pak.json        # Package metadata
    README.md       # Project overview
    LICENSE.md      # License
    doc/            # Documentation structure (this directory)
    dist/           # Distribution files (dist/osdep.h)
    .claude/        # Claude Code configuration
```

## Known Considerations

- The `me.h` config header (generated by MakeMe build system) can override defaults
- VxWorks requires explicit `VXWORKS` define (no auto-detection compiler symbol)
- ESP32/FreeRTOS detection uses multiple markers: `ESP_PLATFORM`, `INC_FREERTOS_H`, `FREERTOS_CONFIG_H`, `ARDUINO`, `FREERTOS`
- TI DSP arch incorrectly maps to `ME_CPU_SPARC` instead of `ME_CPU_TIDSP` (osdep.h line 245)
- `ssize` is always 64-bit on all platforms (maps to `ssize_t`)
